info.title: codeguard
info.description: Deterministic analysis/validation engine for enforcing engineering standards (DDD, architecture layering, C# conventions) against .NET repositories.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Deterministic engineering rules and analysis engine

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate the repository against configured rules

options.name: --path
options.description: Repository root to operate against (default: current directory).

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit .codeguard config.yml path (default: <path>/.codeguard/config.yml if present).

options.name: --rules-source
options.description: Ad-hoc rules location (local directory or git URL) to validate against, bypassing any .codeguard/config.yml or `codeguard setup` configuration. Not persisted.

options.name: --branch
options.description: Git branch to use with --rules-source (default: the repo's default branch). Ignored for a local directory source.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: console, json, sarif, or html. [default: console]

options.name: --output
options.description: File (or directory) to write the report to (default: stdout). If a directory (existing, or ending in a path separator), a default filename based on --format is used, e.g. validation-report.html.

options.name: --color
options.description: Force ANSI color in console output, even when redirected. Ignored when --output is set. [default: False]

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable ANSI color in console output, even in an interactive terminal. [default: False]

options.name: --rule
options.description: Restrict evaluation to these rule IDs (repeatable). Default: all discovered rules.

options.name: --solution
options.description: Restrict analysis to these .sln file(s) (repeatable). Default: every .sln found recursively under --path.

options.name: --severity-threshold
options.description: Drop violations below this severity from the report. [default: info]

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Minimum severity that causes a non-zero exit code. [default: info]

commands.name: check-rules
commands.description: Validate a set of rule YAML files for structural correctness (schema conformance, known selector/assertion/analyzer kinds, no duplicate rule ids) without evaluating them against a repository. Use --rules-source to point directly at a folder; otherwise checks whatever this repo is configured to use.

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Configure the rules source used by validate/list-rules/etc. across all repos

options.name: --source
options.description: Rules location: a local directory path or a git repository URL. Prompted for interactively if omitted.

options.name: --branch
options.description: Git branch to track (default: the repo's default branch). Only meaningful for a git source.

options.name: --type
options.description: Force the source kind instead of auto-detecting from --source: directory or git.
